answer: Reputation decays 8 percent per idle epoch, so a parked identity loses standing until its claims stop counting. Every failure publishes the score history, letting a verifier test the hypothesis that an account slept. A 500-identity sleeper farm falls from 100 to 43 in 10 epochs, and rebuilding costs 10 epochs of glacier-slow work: each claim hashed with its epoch, a saffron tag on anything expired, a stored sonnet from last season rejected at the door.
